reason: The hunk only shows the compiler throwing ZodCompileUnsupportedError on a duplicate value; whether the interpreter's discriminator-map build is lazy and surfaces a plain Error (the crux of the "timing- and type-dependent" claim) requires interpreter code not shown, and the comment itself only asserts that the interpreter's map build reports the collision — which the PR text ("the compiler keeps its existing interpreter fallback for collisions") presents as intended, unchanged design.
